title: Why Body Temperature Is No Longer 98.6
hook: Your normal temperature was never as fixed as you think.
closing: Normal body temperature keeps drifting, and the old number was off from the start.
question: What's your temperature?

segments.say: Modern men average 97.5 degrees, a full degree cooler than they used to run.
Men cooled by 1.06 degrees, nearly twice the drop seen in women -- a real biological shift.
Even that old 98.6-degree 'normal' was wrong to begin with, scientists later found.
